name: Hiro Tachibana
source:
Likes: Muffins
Dislikes: Bothersome things
Hobby: Sleeping
Skills: Art of Sword Drawing

"...I'm not qualified to be a prefect."

Klaus: Hiro always walks a step back behind of Zeus and works as his right-hand man.
He uses magic from Hinamoto and it is said that his outstanding magical skill is one of the best in the Night Class.
For some reason, his magical power is sealed.
Once he gains his magic back, it's certain that he will be a big contribution to the team Prefects and the academy.
The history of Zeus and Hiro is one of the must-see point in his story.
You may find out why Hiro always supports Zeus.

[Official in-game description]
